### 1.1. What v0.2 Adds

v0.2 extends the v0.1 ontology kernel with the Governed Knowledge Lifecycle:

| Layer | v0.1 | v0.2 |
|---|---|---|
| Sources graph | Note, NoteItem (9 types) | Unchanged |
| Candidates graph | — | Candidate (8 lifecycle states) |
| Asserted graph | — | KnowledgeItem, Requirement |
| Inferred graph | — | Reserved (empty) |
| Provenance graph | — | prov:Activity, rdf:Statement |
| Validation | SPARQL data-quality checks (14 CQ queries, 3 negative) | + SHACL shapes (4 files, 12 shapes), + 13 lifecycle CQ queries, + 5 Jena SHACL negative fixtures and 5 named-graph SHACL-SPARQL fixtures |

## 2. Key Design Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Assertion metadata (S2-06) | RDF Reification (`rdf:Statement`) | Preserves v0.1 compatibility, SHACL-native, tool-supported since 1999 |
| `Requirement` class vs `requirement` individual | Distinct IRIs (PascalCase class ≠ kebab-case individual) | Class = asserted knowledge type; individual = source evidence tag |
| Activity type differentiation | Property presence, not OWL subclasses | No CQ requires activity type reasoning yet |
| KnowledgeItem content model | `rdfs:label` on asserted fact; full text in source NoteItem | Avoids duplicating evidentiary text in asserted graph |
| Module split | `provenance.ttl` (lifecycle vocabulary) + `temporal.ttl` (asserted knowledge) | Organizational; both co-members of `v/0.2/` |

## 5. Compatibility

### 5.1. Classification: ADDITIVE (MINOR)

v0.2 is an additive release. No v0.1 IRI was renamed, repurposed, or deleted. All v0.1 queries, graphs, and validation checks continue to work unchanged.

### 5.2. Migration: No-op

No data migration is needed. The executable compatibility artifact is
[`ontology/migrations/0.1.0-to-0.2.0-noop.md`](../../../ontology/migrations/0.1.0-to-0.2.0-noop.md): v0.2 vocabulary and shapes are new files, and existing v0.1 datasets load without modification alongside v0.2.

### 5.3. New Named Graphs

The five-graph model (`/sources`, `/candidates`, `/asserted`, `/inferred`, `/provenance`) replaces Sprint 1's single demo graph. The v0.1 `quick-note-demo.trig` data remains valid in the `/sources` graph.

## 6. Unresolved Questions (Carried Forward)

1. **NoteItem identity for candidate dedup:** Two extractions from the same NoteItem → separate Candidates. Should they link? Deferred to Sprint 3.
2. **Candidate temporal validity:** Do Candidates have `validFrom`/`validTo`, or only asserted KnowledgeItems? Deferred to Sprint 3+.
3. **Retraction vs. Supersession distinction:** Vocabulary supports both; semantics deferred.
4. **Activity subclasses:** `prov:Activity` differentiated by property presence, not OWL subclasses. Revisit if inference/shapes need hard typing.
5. **Automatic extraction:** The lifecycle contract is defined; extraction logic is Sprint 3+.
